question: Which chemical compound is responsible for the spicy taste in chilli peppers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Capsaicin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Capsaicin** is the chemical compound responsible for the spicy taste in chilli peppers.
 
• Capsaicin activates certain receptors in the mouth, which are responsible for the sensation of heat and pain.
 
• This compound is found in the white pith of the pepper, which holds the seeds.
 
• The level of spiciness in peppers is measured
